GLOBAL: scripts/m15-bounty.lua
PLAYER: scripts/m15-reputation.lua
CUSTOM: scripts/m15-local-retention.lua

local world = require('openmw.world')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local done = false
local function update()
    if done then return end
    local player = world.players[1]
    if not player then return end
    local before = types.Player.getCrimeLevel(player)
    assert(before == -3 or before == -4)
    if before == -3 then types.Player.setCrimeLevel(player, -4) end
    assert(types.Player.getCrimeLevel(player) == -4)
    print('M15 bounty Lua before=' .. before .. ' after=-4')
    done = true
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onUpdate=update,onSave=function() return {{done=done}} end,onLoad=function() done=false end}}}}

local self = require('openmw.self')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local done = false
local loads = 0
local frames = 0
local camera = require('openmw.camera')
local function update()
    if done then return end
    local before = types.NPC.stats.reputation(self).current
    assert(before == 16777217 or before == 16777219)
    if before == 16777217 then types.NPC.stats.reputation(self).current = 16777219 end
    assert(types.NPC.stats.reputation(self).current == 16777219)
    print('M15 Fame Lua before=' .. before .. ' after=16777219')
    done = true
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onUpdate=update,onFrame=function() frames=frames+1; if frames==5 then print('M15 reload frame-ready',loads,self.position,camera.getPosition()) end end,onSave=function() return {{done=done,loads=loads}} end,onLoad=function(data) done=false; frames=0; loads=(data and data.loads or 0)+1 end}}}}

local updates = 0
return {{engineHandlers={{onInit=function() print('M15 local retention init') end,onUpdate=function() if updates==0 then print('M15 local retention update') end; updates=updates+1 end,onSave=function() return {{updates=updates}} end,onLoad=function(s) updates=s.updates; assert(updates>0); print('M15 local retention load', updates) end}}}}
